projective_trans_contour_xld — 2D contour op

• Data kinds: contour → contour

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "projective_trans_contour_xld", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: projective_trans_contour_xld (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Applies a pseudo perspective-shrink depending on column position to each point of the contour (dividing each point's coordinates by `d = 1 + 0.3*a*(col - center)/width). Note that this is an approximation using a simple one-directional scale change rather than a true projective transformation via a 3x3 homography matrix. A stand-in for HALCON's projective_trans_contour_xld` (Apply a projective transformation to an XLD contour.).
